sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — My weekend in Hoi An
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
Last weekend, I visited Hoi An with my best friend, Lan. We left Da Nang on Saturday morning and arrived in Hoi An at nine o'clock.

First, we visited a local market. We ate some street food and I bought a small souvenir for my mother. Then we walked around the old town and took lots of photos. In the evening, we attended a weekend event by the river. There was music and there were lots of people. It was beautiful!

We stayed overnight in a small hotel near the river. It wasn't expensive, and the people were very friendly.

On Sunday, it rained all morning, so we didn't go to the beach. Although it rained, we enjoyed the experience. We had a chance to try a cooking class instead.

In the end, we returned home on Sunday evening. I was exhausted, but it was worth it. It was a memorable trip!

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Minh's weekend
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: What did Minh attend?
First, he met his ____ at the bus station.
He tried food from ____ different countries.
What was the best part?
Where did they stay overnight?
They slept a lot.
When did Minh return home?
What was late?

script: Hi Minh! How was your weekend?
It was great, thanks. Last weekend, I attended a food event in the city centre.
First, I met my cousins at the bus station. Then we went to the event together.
I had a chance to try food from ten different countries. The best part was the Korean food.
Did you stay overnight in the city?
Yes, we stayed overnight at my cousin's apartment. We didn't sleep much!
Ha ha. When did you return home?
I returned home on Sunday afternoon. Although the bus was late, I enjoyed the whole trip.
I was exhausted, but it was worth it!

sections.title: Part 4 · Speaking — Shadowing
sections.sub: Nghe mẫu → đọc theo → ghi âm. Máy chấm điểm trên thang 10 và tô màu từng từ.

items.prompt: Tell me about your weekend

sentences.text: Last weekend, I visited a local market with my family.
Then we attended a weekend event in the park.
I had a chance to try some local food.
The best part was the night market.
It rained on Sunday, so we didn't go to the beach.
I was exhausted, but it was worth it.
